$comment: The published artifacts the stock-image plugin proof runs against. Every value is null and
status is 'pending' because the qualifying release does not exist yet: it is the first
successful prerelease publication carrying both DMS-1499's plugin loader and DMS-1433's
custom-validator fan-in step, cut after this ticket's version-specific image tagging merged.
Nothing here may be guessed. A fabricated tag or digest would make the proof a statement
about an artifact nobody published, which is the one thing this tier exists not to be.
Test-StockImagePinReadiness.ps1 refuses a half-filled pin in either direction: a 'pending'
pin carrying values, and a 'published' pin missing any of them, are both invalid rather
edFiApi is pinned by version-specific tag AND digest. configurationService is pinned by
digest alone: this ticket adds version-specific tags to the Ed-Fi API publication only, so
the Configuration Service still carries nothing but the moving 'pre' tag, and a bare digest
is honest about that where a tag plus digest would imply a version-specific tag exists.
tooling and contracts pin what the harness consumes rather than builds: the released
SchemaTools package that provisions the database the pinned runtime validates, and the two
published contract packages the fixture plugin compiles against. Building the fixture from
this branch against this branch's contracts would test version skew rather than plugin
loading, and would stop working the moment either contract surface moved.
